scene.title: Ball kicked at 45° trajectory
scene.summary: A ball launched at 45° follows a parabola: horizontal speed stays constant, vertical speed changes due to gravity, reaching a peak then landing.

beats.title: Kick at 45°
beats.narration: The ball is kicked from the ground at 45°, splitting its speed into equal horizontal and vertical components.

beats.title: Speed components
beats.narration: The launch speed resolves into a horizontal part vₓ and a vertical part v_y, each half the magnitude.

check.question: What shape will the ball’s path take?
check.explain: Gravity causes a constant horizontal speed and a uniformly accelerated vertical speed, producing a parabola.

beats.title: Parabolic path
beats.narration: Gravity pulls the ball down, curving its motion into a parabola.

beats.title: Peak and landing
beats.narration: The ball reaches its highest point at 10.2 m after 20.4 m and lands 40.8 m away.

beats.title: Result
beats.narration: A 45° launch gives the longest range; the path is a parabola with range 40.8 m.
